scope: Correction only: Polish party identity evidence now lists each PKW communiqué that prints the EwP number and is labelled as such. No election result or link changes.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner replies: register the gazette hosts for named documents; accept gazette-published PKW notices as closing the reuse gates for national figures under Art. 4 of the Copyright Act; allow one reading each of the Electoral Code, Copyright Act, Supreme Court validity resolutions and the PKW communiqué.
Owner brief: correct misleading evidence labels without changing verified results.

reuse_right.basis: Art. 4(2) of the Copyright Act excludes official documents and materials from copyright. This is a reading of the statute, accepted by the owner, not a statement by PKW; commentary disputes how far 'official material' extends.

raw_redistribution.basis: Only Part I text is archived, with the PDF checksum. Part II names every candidate and is not committed.

acquisition_route.basis: One sequential request per named document on eli.gov.pl, 5 seconds apart; robots.txt allows all paths. api.sejm.gov.pl rejected its first request and is unused.

source_files_complete.basis: Each notice's Part I holds electorate, ballots, turnout, valid and invalid votes, and votes and seats by committee.

national_definition_complete.basis: Published turnout reproduces as valid ballots / eligible voters; valid plus invalid votes equal valid ballots; list votes sum to valid votes; seats sum to 460; shares reproduce within rounding.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Each list keeps its printed committee name and list number (not unique: three 2023 committees share number 11). Committee type follows the official name under Art. 84 § 2. Coalition members are not stated and not derived; coalition votes and seats are never divided.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: Art. 193, 196, 197 and 232 are identical in the 2011, 2019 and 2022 texts. The version in force in 2015 was not read separately; the 2015 notice applies Art. 196 § 1 and § 2.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: Each election uses the PKW notice, and the Supreme Court declared each election valid. A search for later corrections to the notices was not exhaustive.

continuity: A same_party link needs Electoral Code Art. 92 § 1 and the same EwP number printed by PKW in Monitor Polski. Five parties reviewed; other repeated committee names stay unresolved.
evidence_limits: The latest communiqué read covers 2021; the 2023 link rests on that and Art. 92 § 1.
The owner's Art. 4 decision named result notices; these communiqués use the same basis, flagged for owner review before publication.
